preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The input string must not be empty.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'hHaA' for c in kooka_sound)
preconditions.description: The input string must only contain the characters 'h', 'H', 'a', and 'A'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the string representation of the number of kookaburras.
The number of kookaburras is equal to the length of the input string divided by 4.
